name: @atum-labs/award-hash
description: Single cross-language source of the BidAwardEnvelope award_hash binding (the proof.challenge of an award-authority VP): keccak256 over a domain-separated (payment_id, quote_hash, settler_id) preimage. Pinned byte-for-byte to the Go binding by conformance/award-hash-golden.json.

scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
